import time
from radia_mcp.radia_ngsolve.knowledge.urn import urn_fit_from_csv

# Real measured TDK PC47 MnZn-ferrite complex impedance (freq, Z_real, Z_imag); header at line 19.
csv = "../../examples/universal_relaxation_network/data/real_world/tdk_ferrite/tdk_pc47_impedance.csv"
t0 = time.time()
report = urn_fit_from_csv(csv, freq_col=0, real_col=1, imag_col=2, skip_rows=19,
                         n_debye=3, n_cole_cole=2, n_warburg=1,
                         n_epochs=1200, n_restarts=2)
print(f"[live URN fit on TDK PC47 ferrite impedance, {time.time() - t0:.1f} s]\n")
print(report)
